name: Daily Shikaku
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Shikaku is a puzzle game that will help give your mind daily training. If you are looking for a daily challenge, then look no further! The objective is to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle. Whether you want something easy or want to really hurt your brain, this game has different modes for you to play. This online game has 4 modes: 5x5, 7x7, 10x10, and 15x15. Select the mode, and start playing! If you really want to challenge yourself, play all 4 modes in a day. If you cannot get enough of this puzzle game, click on the calendar icon to play the puzzles from the archives. You can even get ahead and play tomorrow’s daily game! Daily Shikaku is the perfect game for the player who enjoys mind games.
